description: A man in a brown leather jacket sits on brownstone steps at dusk, writing in a small notebook. Beside him are a boombox, a black milk crate of vinyl records, and a folding table holding two turntables and a mixer, with cables trailing off the edge. Behind are brick apartment blocks with fire escapes and lit windows, and a few figures in a courtyard. The painting is warm and painterly, with no visible text, frame or border.
